Jumarakaumudī
on Saṅkṣiptasāra gr. by Yadunandana. Adyar II. p. 86b. Adyar D. VI. 720 (Kṛdanta an. Kāraka).

Jumara(jūmara)nandin
reviser of C. Rasavatī of Kramadīśvara on latter's Saṅkṣiptasāra. gr. See IO. 815. 5071-2. Oxf. 173b. 174a-b. See also Belvalkar, Systems of Skt. Gr. p.. 108-10.
--Uṇādi(sūtra)pariśiṣṭavṛtti. Part of C. on Saṅkṣiptasāra. IO. 834. 835.
--Taddhitapariśiṣṭa. gr. PUL. II. p. 82.
--Dhātupārāyaṇa. a. appendix to Saṅkṣiptasāra. L. 1640.
--Dhātumālā. gr. Hpr. I. 196.

Jumarīya
ref. to by Rāmanātha in his C. Trikāṇḍaviveka on Amarakośa, IO. 963.
